name: Himemiya Touri
source:
Tori is the eldest son of the wealthy Himemiya clan. He is the young master of Yuzuru Fushimi, who served him as a butler and consultant since their childhood. Tori is bright, ingenious, and proud as a noble. His singing voice is sweet and angelic, accompanied by adorable performances.

Tori is a member of fine at STARMAKER PRODUCTION.

[From in-game profile]
